subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 grouped action upgrades land together after exact-head security review, or should the credential-bearing and Codex/CodeQL updates be split into narrower PRs?
rationale: These revisions execute third-party code with materially different permissions and secrets, so automated checks cannot decide the repository's acceptable grouped supply-chain risk.

options.title: Review stable grouped head
options.body: Wait for Dependabot to produce a stable rebased head, inspect the upstream deltas, and require targeted exact-head workflow proof before merging the group.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, CodeQL, app-token, registry, and publishing actions from routine setup and repository-maintenance action updates for narrower review.

options.title: Pause this update
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until Dependabot access and rebase churn are resolved or replace it with maintainer-authored pin updates.

recommendation.title: Review stable grouped head
recommendation.body: Wait for Dependabot to produce a stable rebased head, inspect the upstream deltas, and require targeted exact-head workflow proof before merging the group.
